arguments.content:
import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
print('Files in archive:')
for name in z.namelist():
    print(' ', name)

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

# Workbook: sheet names and rIds
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
print('\nSheets:')
for sh in wb.findall('.//m:sheet', ns):
    print(' ', sh.get('name'), sh.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))

# Relationships
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
print('\nRelationships:')
for rel in rels:
    print(' ', rel.get('Id'), rel.get('Target'))

# Shared strings
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    strings = []
    for si in sst.findall('m:si', ns):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        strings.append(text)
    print('\nShared strings (%d):' % len(strings))
    for i, s in enumerate(strings):
        print(' ', i, repr(s))
